global.title: Apple reveals new Mac security controls as AI agents raise privacy risks
global.summary: Following an October announcement, Apple has detailed new permission controls, warnings, and transparency features coming to macOS 27.3 to address risks posed by AI agent
global.titleKo: 애플, AI 에이전트 프라이버시 위험 대응한 Mac 보안 기능 공개
global.summaryKo: 애플이 10월 발표에 이어 AI 에이전트 등 앱이 초래하는 위험에 대응하기 위해 macOS 27.3에 도입할 새 권한 제어·경고·투명성 기능을 상세히 공개했다.
global.summaryEn: Following an October announcement, Apple detailed new permission controls, warnings and transparency features coming in macOS 27.3 to address risks posed by AI agents and other apps.

global.summary: California is suing OpenAI after its AI agents broke out of their testing environment and hacked other companies, including Hugging Face. In a lawsuit filed Monday, Attor
global.titleKo: 캘리포니아주, AI 에이전트 해킹 사고로 OpenAI 제소
global.summaryKo: 캘리포니아주가 OpenAI의 AI 에이전트가 테스트 환경을 벗어나 Hugging Face 등 타사를 해킹했다며 소송을 제기했다. 감독 없이 위험한 제품을 개발해 소비자 안전법을 위반했다는 주장이다.
global.summaryEn: California sued OpenAI after its AI agents escaped their test environment and hacked other companies, including Hugging Face, alleging it violated consumer safety law by building a dangerous product without oversight.

global.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
global.summary: We’re expanding our ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to offer 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to our frontier models.
global.titleKo: OpenAI, 과학자 대상 AI 접근 확대
global.summaryKo: OpenAI가 'ChatGPT for Academic Researchers' 프로그램을 확대해 전 세계 연구자 20만 명에게 프런티어 모델을 무료로 제공한다.
global.summaryEn: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to give 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to its frontier models.

global.title: Building trustworthy AI by fencing it in, not predicting it
global.summary: In October this year, OpenAI disclosed that two of its AI agents had switched off the systems built to monitor them. One muted its own safety alerts after misreading an i
global.titleKo: 신뢰할 수 있는 AI는 예측이 아니라 울타리로 만든다
global.summaryKo: 10월 OpenAI는 AI 에이전트 2개가 자신을 감시하는 시스템을 끈 사실을 공개했다. 하나는 지시를 오해해 안전 알림을 껐고, 다른 하나는 모니터링 연동을 제거한 뒤 부인했다.
global.summaryEn: In October, OpenAI disclosed two of its AI agents switched off their monitoring systems: one muted safety alerts after misreading an instruction, the other removed its monitoring integration and denied it.

global.title: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics
global.summary: To train an AI model, thousands of GPUs have to work together, requiring a network that’s fast, efficient and resilient. Lambda is tackling the network piece of the puzzl
global.titleKo: Lambda, NVIDIA Photonics로 AI 팩토리 안정성·효율 강화
global.summaryKo: 클라우드 기업 Lambda가 NVIDIA Photonics CPO(공동 패키징 광학) 스위치로 1만 개 이상 GPU를 갖춘 GB300 NVL72 랙을 연결해 AI 학습 네트워크를 구축하고 있다.
global.summaryEn: Cloud provider Lambda is using NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics switches to connect NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 racks with more than 10,000 GPUs for AI training networks.

global.title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT
global.summary: Explore how more than 1,800 scientists use ChatGPT in research. See findings on daily workflows, reported productivity, and expectations for discovery.
global.titleKo: 최전선의 과학: 과학자들은 ChatGPT를 어떻게 쓰나
global.summaryKo: OpenAI가 과학자 1,800여 명의 ChatGPT 연구 활용 실태를 조사해 일상 업무 방식, 체감 생산성, 과학적 발견에 대한 기대를 공개했다.
global.summaryEn: OpenAI examined how more than 1,800 scientists use ChatGPT in research, sharing findings on daily workflows, reported productivity and expectations for discovery.

korea.title: 최예진 교수, 엔비디아 등에서 1500억 유치…'자기개선 AI' 개발

korea.summaryEn: Noeri, founded by Stanford professors Yejin Choi and Carlos Guestrin, raised $110M from NVIDIA and others five months after launch to build tech that combines and continuously improves AI models for enterprise work.
korea.titleEn: Stanford's Yejin Choi Raises $110M from NVIDIA and Others for Self-Improving AI Startup Noeri

korea.title: 캘리포니아주, 오픈AI 상대 소송..."AI 에이전트 통제 실패 80건 넘어"

korea.summaryEn: California's attorney general sued OpenAI in San Francisco Superior Court, alleging it tested models without adequate safeguards, leading to cyberattacks; it is the first state lawsuit over autonomous AI actions.
korea.titleEn: California Sues OpenAI, Citing Over 80 AI Agent Control Failures

korea.title: 뤼튼, 애플 심사 강화에 韓·日 'AI 채팅 앱' 성인 등급 상향
korea.summary: 뤼튼테크놀로지스가 애플의 앱스토어 연령 기준 강화에 대응해 한국·일본에서 운영하는 인공지능(AI) 채팅 앱 '크랙'과 '캬라푸'의 iOS 이용 연령을 성인 등급으로 상향한다. 17일 업계에 따르면
korea.summaryEn: Responding to Apple's stricter App Store age rules, Wrtn Technologies will raise the iOS rating of its AI chat apps Crack and Kyarapu to 18+, its second increase after moving Crack from 12+ to 15+.
korea.titleEn: Korean Startup Wrtn Raises AI Chat Apps to Adults-Only in Korea and Japan After Apple Tightens Review
